we propose a simple and effective method for modeling complex interactions between a context paragraph and a query, and our model achieves new state-of-the-art on two challenging MC benchmarks.
we introduce the BIDAF network, which is a bi-directional attention based neural network that uses hierarchical context representation for machine comprehension.

The main takeaway from our work is that
bi-directional attention can be an effective mechanism for modeling interactions between the context, the query and the answer in MC.
bi-directional attention is a powerful mechanism for MC, and that a hierarchical model that uses bi-directional attentions at different layers can be a promising architecture for MC.
the bi-directional attention is a simple yet effective technique that can be applied to a wide range of tasks.
